camel_example: aliyun ndr ListEntities --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy LastSeenTime --PageSize 10 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --Lang zh --RecommendStatus 1 --EntityType.1 1 --EntityKey '192.0.2.10' --EntityUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --RecommendAction observe --IsExternal true --IncidentUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --HideBlocked true --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paging query on event-associated or global entities, and returns entity property, association statistics, and recommended action summary
description_zh: 分页查询事件关联实体或全局实体，返回实体属性、关联统计和推荐处置摘要
kebab_example: aliyun ndr list-entities --page 1 --page-size 10 --incident-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-key 192.0.2.10 --entity-type 1 --is-external true --hide-blocked true --recommend-status 1 --recommend-action observe --order-by LastSeenTime --sort-order desc --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEntities

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. If this parameter is not specified, the global entity list is queried
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID。不传时查询全局实体列表
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity. You can obtain the ID from ListEntities
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The business value of the entity, such as an IP address, domain name, or cloud instance ID. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 实体的业务值，例如 IP 地址、域名或云实例 ID，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: entity_key

parameters.help_en: The list of entity types. A value of 1 indicates an IP address, 2 indicates a cloud instance, 3 indicates a host account, 4 indicates a domain name, 5 indicates a back-to-origin aggregation node for cloud services, and 6 indicates a file. If this parameter is not specified, type 5 is excluded by default
parameters.help_zh: 实体类型列表。1 表示 IP，2 表示云实例，3 表示主机账号，4 表示域名，5 表示云产品回源聚合节点，6 表示文件。不传时默认排除类型 5
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the entity is an external entity. A value of true indicates that only external entities are queried. A value of false indicates that only internal entities are queried. If this parameter is not specified, entities are not filtered by internal or external attributes
parameters.help_zh: 是否为外部实体。true 表示仅查询外部实体，false 表示仅查询内部实体；不传时不按内外部属性过滤
parameters.name: is_external

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to hide entities that have been blocked. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否隐藏已生效封禁的实体，默认 false
parameters.name: hide_blocked

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not used for query filtering. Do not specify this parameter. For the recommended action status, see Recommendation.Status
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，当前不参与查询过滤，请勿设置。推荐处置状态请查看 Recommendation.Status
parameters.name: recommend_status

parameters.help_en: The recommended action filter. A value of block indicates blocking, observe indicates observing, allow indicates allowing, and none indicates no recommended action
parameters.help_zh: 推荐处置动作筛选。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作
parameters.name: recommend_action

parameters.help_en: The sort field. A value of LastSeenTime indicates the time when the entity was last discovered, and EntityKey indicates the entity value
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。LastSeenTime 表示最近发现时点，EntityKey 表示实体值
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of asc indicates ascending order, and desc indicates descending order. The default value is desc for LastSeenTime and asc for EntityKey
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；LastSeenTime 默认 desc，EntityKey 默认 asc
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. A value of zh indicates Chinese, and en indicates English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The query results or the data returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

AliyunTipInfo.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud threat intelligence information

Confidence.description_en: The confidence level of the threat intelligence

GeoInfo.description_en: The geographic information of the IP address

Country.description_en: The name of the country or region

ThreatLevel.description_en: The risk level returned by the threat intelligence
ThreatLevel.description_zh: 威胁情报返回的风险等级

BlockingStatus.description_en: The blocking status. A value of -1 indicates no blocking configuration, 0 indicates not in effect, and 1 indicates in effect
BlockingStatus.description_zh: 封禁状态。-1 表示无封禁配置，0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效
BlockingStatus.title_en: 封禁状态：-1无封禁配置，0未生效，1已生效
BlockingStatus.title_zh: 封禁状态：-1无封禁配置，0未生效，1已生效

BlockingWhitelisted.description_en: Indicates whether the entity is in the blocking whitelist

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the entity

EntityKey.description_en: The business value of the entity, such as an IP address, a domain name, or a cloud instance ID
EntityKey.description_zh: 实体的业务值，例如 IP 地址、域名或云实例 ID

EntityType.description_en: The entity type. A value of 1 indicates an IP address, 2 indicates a cloud instance, 3 indicates a host account, 4 indicates a domain name, 5 indicates a back-to-origin aggregation node for cloud services, and 6 indicates a file
EntityType.description_zh: 实体类型。1 表示 IP，2 表示云实例，3 表示主机账号，4 表示域名，5 表示云产品回源聚合节点，6 表示文件

EntityUuid.description_en: The ID of the entity. You can obtain the ID from ListEntities
EntityUuid.description_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the associated cloud instance

InstanceType.description_en: The type of the associated cloud instance

InstanceVpc.description_en: The VPC where the associated instance resides

IsExternal.description_en: Indicates whether the entity is external. A value of true indicates an external entity, and a value of false indicates an internal entity
IsExternal.description_zh: 是否为外部实体。true 表示外部实体，false 表示内部实体

LastSeenTime.description_en: The last time the entity was discovered, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastSeenTime.description_zh: 实体最近发现时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
LastSeenTime.title_en: 实体最后发现时间，Unix毫秒
LastSeenTime.title_zh: 实体最后发现时间，Unix毫秒

Recommendation.description_en: The summary of the recommended response for the entity. The recommendation does not indicate that the action has been executed
Recommendation.description_zh: 实体的推荐处置摘要；建议不代表操作已执行

Action.description_en: The recommended response action. A value of block indicates blocking, observe indicates observing, allow indicates allowing, and none indicates no recommended action
Action.description_zh: 推荐处置动作。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作

Duration.description_en: The recommended blocking duration in seconds. A value of -1 indicates permanent blocking. This parameter is valid only when blocking is recommended
Duration.description_zh: 建议封禁时长，单位为秒；-1 表示永久。仅在建议封禁时有意义
Duration.title_en: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久
Duration.title_zh: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久

ReviewTime.description_en: The time of the most recent response review, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ReviewTime.description_zh: 最近一次处置研判时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Status.description_en: The generation status of the recommended response result. A value of processing indicates the result is being generated for the first time, updating indicates the result is being updated, completed indicates the generation is complete, failed indicates the first generation failed, and update_failed indicates the update failed. When the status is updating or update_failed, the previous valid recommendation result is retained
Status.description_zh: 推荐处置结果的生成状态。processing 表示首次生成中，updating 表示更新中，completed 表示完成，failed 表示首次生成失败，update_failed 表示更新失败。updating 和 update_failed 时可保留上一次有效推荐结果

Summary.description_en: The summary of the recommended response
Summary.example: 建议核对访问行为并持续观察。

RelateAlertCount.description_en: The number of raw alerts associated with the entity in the last 30 days. This is not limited to the number of alerts in the current incident
RelateAlertCount.description_zh: 实体近 30 天关联的原始告警数量，不是仅当前事件内的数量

RelateIncidentCount.description_en: The number of security events associated with the entity in the last 30 days, counted by the most recent occurrence time of the events. This is not limited to the number of events in the current incident
RelateIncidentCount.description_zh: 实体近 30 天关联的安全事件数量，按事件最近发生时点统计；不是仅当前事件内的数量

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, starting from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the cause of the failure
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
